text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Team & Governance Document passage states the steering committee meets bi-weekly, matching the claim and its attributed document."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Project Overview Document says the steering committee will conduct a quarterly review to track progress against success metrics; the claim's note that this is a review rather than a meeting schedule is a faithful reading, since no meeting schedule is stated there."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"This is an absence claim that only says the documents do not state conflicting meeting frequencies, and it asserts no other project facts."}]}
